posts.title: WORD OF THE DAY "Refuted"
posts.description: Cummins: Denial, not just a river in Egypt L et's remind ourselves of the difference between two words: 'refuted' and 'rebutted.' 'Refuted' means to "prove (a statement or theory) to be wrong or false." See that word "prove"? That's the key word here: " Prove ." Whereas 'rebutted' simply means "to argue or push back." posts.description: " O ne of the most persistent misconceptions in economics is the belief that whenever one person gains from a transaction, somebody else must lose.
